# Mitchell Heating & Cooling

> Mitchell Heating & Cooling provides heating and cooling service to homeowners in and around Mitchell, Perth/Huron, Ontario. The team handles furnace and AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump service, gas fireplace work, thermostat upgrades, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (519) 348-4027  |  Email: contact@mitchellheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://mitchellheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Mitchell, Stratford, Seaforth, Goderich, Listowel, Clinton, Wingham
